Where the run landed

Calibration: since 2026-10-01 the PowerDirector Mobile for iOS pool is 61% Sev 2 and 37% Sev 3; Sev 1 is 1.6% (4 tickets). This batch proposes one S1 (video never completes), six S2 and the rest S3. Copy and spec-conflict items stay at S3 because the pool almost never uses Sev 4. Nine entries already exist in ECL, so they start on hold with the matching ticket named. Reopen or comment on those instead of filing.

Gaps you should know about

22 cases are Blocked, with no verdict. Most need a working video (TC-086 fails 3/3) or a state this account or device can't reach. Fault injection used the Pink debug menu, and all of its toggles were set back to Off at the end. Evidence comes from screenshots only; audio (narration) could not be checked.
